## applications (`/api/ui/applications`)

Application definitions — the root entity. Contains app name, code, type, default/shell/login pages, themes, styles, icon packs, font packs, manifest, and CSP settings.

**CRUD pattern:** `mongo_crud`
  - `POST /api/ui/applications/` — Create new entity
  - `GET /api/ui/applications/{id}` — Get entity by ID
  - `GET /api/ui/applications/` — List entities with pagination — params: eager: boolean — include related entities (default false), clientOnly: boolean — filter to current client only (default false), page: int (default 0), size: int (default 10)
  - `PUT /api/ui/applications/{id}` — Full update — replaces entity
  - `DELETE /api/ui/applications/{id}` — Delete entity by ID

**Schema fields:**
  - `name`: string — application display name
  - `appCode`: string — unique app code
  - `clientCode`: string — owning client code
  - `appType`: string — APP or SITE
  - `properties` (object):
    - `title`: string — browser tab title
    - `defaultPage`: string — page name shown after login
    - `shellPage`: string — layout wrapper page (optional)
    - `loginPage`: string — login page name (optional)
    - `forbiddenPage`: string — 403 page name (optional)
    - `iconPacks`: array — icon library names (e.g. fa-solid, fa-brands)
    - `fontPacks`: array — [{name, url}] for Google Fonts
    - `links`: array — [{rel, href}] for favicon etc.
    - `manifest`: object — PWA manifest {name, short_name, theme_color, display}
    - `csp`: object — Content Security Policy directives
    - `themes`: array — theme names to include
    - `styles`: array — style names to include

**Custom endpoints:**
  - `GET /api/ui/applications/{appCode}/mobileApps?clientCode=string` — List mobile apps for an application
